subcategory_text: Implement improvements to the SDLC that target the systemic root causes of identified vulnerabilities and measure their effectiveness over time.
implementation_examples: Add a new SAST rule triggered by a recurring vulnerability pattern
Update secure-coding training based on root-cause findings
Track vulnerability-recurrence metrics after improvements are deployed
assessment_objectives: Determine whether systemic improvements are implemented after root-cause analysis.
Determine whether improvement effectiveness is measured.
